rulings.why: The page cannot tell these changes from the row: movedown:1.2: Stanza 1's row: system 1 ends on 'in' and system 2 opens 'Thee; I'. 'Thee' is a capitalised pronoun of God and 'I' is always a capital, so the capitals read the same in either layout. The header prints no metre that fixes the lines. movedown:3.2: Stanza 3's row: system 1 ends on 'to' and system 2 opens 'Thee; I'. Both words carry a capital anyway (a pronoun of God, then 'I'). The header prints no metre that fixes the lines. movedown:4.2: Stanza 4's row: system 1 ends on 'from' and system 2 opens 'Thee; I'. Both words carry a capital anyway (a pronoun of God, then 'I'). The header prints no metre that fixes the lines.
